documents.title: Required documents
documents.metaDescription: Documents you need to bring for notarial procedures at the office of Dr. Eurela Mujaj, Shkodër.
documents.lead: The documents you need to bring vary according to the type of notarial deed.
documents.note: This list is indicative. Requirements may vary depending on the specific case and applicable legislation.
documents.ctaTitle: Your case is not on the list?
documents.ctaBody: Contact us and we will tell you exactly what to bring.

dokumentet: Property title / extract from ASHK (State Cadastre Agency)
ID card or passport of seller and buyer
Marriage/family certificate (if the property is joint marital property)
Notarial power of attorney (if either party is represented)
Proof of settled property taxes/fees (if required)
ID document of the person granting the power of attorney
Full details of the person receiving it (name, father's name, address)
Clear description of the authorized action(s)
For powers of attorney intended for use abroad: check apostille requirements in advance
ID document of the testator
Full details of heirs/beneficiaries (name, father's name, address)
Description of the assets involved (if specified individually)
Death certificate of the deceased
Family certificate
ID documents of the heirs
Property titles for inherited assets (if any)
ID documents of the donor and the beneficiary
Property title of the asset being donated
Family certificate (if the donation is between relatives)
ID documents of both parties (landlord and tenant)
Property title of the rented property
Terms of the agreement (duration, rent amount)
